description: Pro. Score a site in one call. Crawls the site from `url` (same origin only, up to 40 pages, 4 requests at a time, or only the `paths` you list), uses sitemap.xml to find pages, and obeys robots.txt for the user agent ATPDesigners. Reads static HTML only. The result opens with coverage: pages read of pages found, which were skipped or truncated, and requests used. Runs the inventory, meta, heading and link health checks over the same crawl and returns a 0 to 100 score per area (each check has a weight; points lost are weight times the share of pages or links affected; the formula is printed in the result), an overall average, and the top 10 issues. Optional `maxLinkChecks` lowers the link check cap.

maxLinkChecks.description: Optional lower cap on extra link requests. The hard cap is 60.

maxPages.description: Optional lower page cap. The hard cap is 40 pages.

paths.description: Optional list of same-origin paths such as /about. When given, only these pages are read and links are not followed.

sitemap.description: Use sitemap.xml to find pages. Default true.

url.description: Home page or any page on the site. The crawl stays on this origin.
